description: This Java source file defines the factory class 'InfoProviderFactory' for creating instances of 'ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider'. The factory provides methods for generating info providers based on ExternalMessage, Signal, and headers, extracting correlation IDs, thing IDs, and payloads accordingly.

classes.name: InfoProviderFactory
classes.description: Factory class with static methods to create 'ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider' instances based on different input types such as ExternalMessage, Signal, and headers.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider using data from an ExternalMessage, extracting correlation ID, timestamp, and payload.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider based on a Signal, extracting correlation ID, timestamp, and optional thing ID.

methods.name: forHeaders
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider solely based on provided headers.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an InfoProvider with default/fallback data.
